verdict.rationale: Snyk documents risk-based prioritization, a single risk score combining prevalence/ease-of-fix, policy management, and the ability to ignore specific findings to suppress noise (snyk-docs-4, snyk-docs-5, snyk-docs-17, snyk-docs-32), which supports triage-by-severity/confidence. However, there is no explicit documentation in this pack of CLI/CI gating flags (e.g., severity-threshold build-break controls) and community feedback flags persistent noise from low-severity findings not matching real risk context (snyk-comm-10), suggesting the feature doesn't fully eliminate noise in practice. Missing for 10: explicit severity/confidence threshold gating docs for CI/CD, and independent confirmation that noise filtering works well in practice.
